items.title: Health-recheck BCTC monitor misreads idle-queue-0-running as CRASH (push-age>360min false P0)
items.desc: The analysis-agent health-recheck cron flags vn-bctc-fetch as CRASHED/UNHEALTHY (SLA breach) whenever last-push-age > 360min, but cannot distinguish a legitimately IDLE pipeline (service active+running, queue EMPTY because 9-11 watchlist tickers simply have not filed Q1-2026 yet) from an actual DOWN service. dev-team SSH RAW-verified 2026-06-19T16:20Z (report 3256): vn-bctc-fetch active(running) 8+ days, NO crash, queue legitimately empty. This monitor fires a false BCTC P0 ~every 2h, spamming health-recheck reports (~14 of reports 3244-3262). DISTINCT FROM FIX-BCTC-FRESHNESS-GATE (done_verified) which gates SERVICE health on last_success_age — that is the inverse (make gate MORE sensitive); THIS task makes the CRASH classifier require service-state + queue-depth probe before declaring crash. Same class as memory feedback_bctc_lastpush_age_misread_as_crash + feedback_false_infra_failure_corroboration_gate.
items.root_cause: Crash detector keys on last-push-age>360min alone (event-driven push age) without checking service-state (active/running) AND queue-depth. push-age is high whenever the queue is empty/idle (no filings due), which is normal off-filing-season, not a crash.
items.fix_spec: Locate the BCTC crash/SLA classifier feeding the analysis-agent health-recheck report (candidates: apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/financial-reports/bctcOverdueCheckJob.ts, scheduler/vpsProxyWatchdogJob.ts, interface/mcp/routes/fetchStatusHandler.ts). Gate the CRASH/UNHEALTHY verdict on: service-state != active/running OR (queue-depth > 0 AND last-success-age > SLA). When queue-depth == 0 AND service running == idle-waiting -> emit INFO (idle, no filings due), NEVER P0 crash. Generic: derive SLA window only over tickers with an EXPECTED-but-missing filing, not calendar age. Add a unit test: idle-queue-0-running + push-age>360min -> verdict=IDLE/INFO (not CRASH); down-service OR (queue>0 AND age>SLA) -> CRASH.
items.verification_gate: Unit: idle-queue-0-running + push-age>360min => INFO not CRASH; service-down => CRASH; queue>0 & age>SLA => CRASH. Live: next health-recheck cron tick over a running-idle vn-bctc-fetch emits NO false BCTC P0.
items.generic_mandate: Fix the classifier generically (service-state + queue-depth gate), not a vn-bctc-fetch special-case; applies to any event-driven pipeline whose push-age is idle-dependent.

items.title: Structural-template validator for FB posts — canonical header, verbatim disclaimer, valid hashtag block, no markdown in body
items.root_cause: 2026-06-23 daily FB post (docs/social/fb-post-2026-06-23.md) PASSED both number-gates (fb-jargon-gate.sh exit 0 AND fb-data-integrity-gate.sh exit 0) while violating the post TEMPLATE in 4 ways — caught only by router manual review. NEW DEFECT CLASS validated by NEITHER existing gate. 3rd+ consecutive day structural/prose defects slipped the number-gates.
defects: Non-canonical header: emitted '# Bài phân tích thị trường 23/6 — ...' instead of required '# Thị trường chứng khoán Việt Nam — YYYY-MM-DD'.
Invented disclaimer block instead of the verbatim standard one (must start '⚠️ Nội dung được tạo tự động bởi bot AI, chưa được kiểm chứng...').

Broken hashtag block: emitted hashtags WITH diacritics and spaces ('#ThịTrườngChứngKhoán', '#Việt Nam' — the space splits into a broken tag). Facebook hashtags cannot contain diacritics or spaces. Required = lowercase no-diacritic ASCII set (#chungkhoan #chungkhoanvietnam #vnindex ...).
Heavy markdown (## headers, ** bold, --- rules) in the body region — pastes as literal characters on Facebook.
items.fix_spec: Add a structural validator (new scripts/fb-structure-gate.sh, or a Check block in fb-data-integrity-gate.sh) that asserts: (1) canonical header line matches regex '^# Thị trường chứng khoán Việt Nam — \\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'; (2) verbatim standard disclaimer block is present; (3) hashtag block is all-lowercase ASCII, no diacritics, no spaces, and includes the mandatory 5 (#chungkhoan #chungkhoanvietnam #vnindex + the two others in the canonical set); (4) no markdown '##' / '**' / '---' inside the body region. Exit NON-ZERO on ANY miss (heed the prior fb-gate false-green class — feedback_fb_poster_gate_false_green — verify it actually exits non-zero).

items.title: system-auditor C-11 (pdf_documents) check predicate broken: queries status=done (never exists) + ISO-8601 vs datetime() strcompare bypass -> ALWAYS false-fails
items.description: C-11 (docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md L478 spec table + bun:sqlite probe) is: count(*) FROM pdf_documents WHERE status='done' AND extracted_at > datetime('now','-48 hours'). RAW live probe (pdf_extractor.db, 2026-06-25T00:37Z, 42233 rows): DISTINCT status = failed(40758)/processing(1376)/success(99) -- there is NO 'done' status, so the predicate ALWAYS returns 0 and C-11 false-fails on every scan. TWO bugs: (1) status literal 'done' must be 'success' (the real terminal-OK status); (2) extracted_at on success rows is ISO-8601 with T separator (e.g. 2026-06-15T22:13:09.472421) while datetime('now','-48 hours') returns space-separated, so the string compare bypasses (feedback_sqlite_iso8601_datetime_strcompare_bypass) and even after fixing the status literal the 48h window mis-evaluates. failed/processing rows have NULL extracted_at.
items.fix_spec: Correct C-11 in BOTH the L478 spec table row AND any bun:sqlite probe block: (a) status='done' -> status='success' (verified the ONLY terminal-OK value; failed/processing are the other two). (b) Replace the ISO-8601-vs-datetime() string compare with an epoch-seconds compare so the 48h window evaluates correctly against the T-format column, e.g. WHERE status='success' AND strftime('%s',replace(extracted_at,'T',' ')) > strftime('%s','now','-48 hours'). GENERIC: no date literals. (c) C-11 is gated > 0 in the earnings window; an out-of-season 0 (Q2 filings land Jul-Aug) should be INFO not HIGH -- apply the same off-market/earnings-season-awareness pattern already prescribed for C-06 (FIX-AUDITOR-C06-OFFMARKET-RECALIBRATE).

items.title: fb-gate Check-C: negation-blind to Vietnamese 'chưa' false-blocks orderly-pullback posts + \d->[0-9] BSD-grep portability
items.lesson: L4 (2026-06-25 -0,80% orderly post FALSE-BLOCKED twice: 'chưa hoảng loạn'/'chưa phải bán tháo' counted AFFIRMATIVE — 'chưa' absent from Check-C negation-strip set)
items.desc: Check-C builds SELLOFF_AFFIRM_LINES by removing lines that match the negation set {không phải|không có|không bán|chứ không|mà không} (line ~342). 'chưa' (not yet/not) is NOT in that set, so an explicitly-negated panic statement ('lực bán chưa hoảng loạn', 'chưa phải bán tháo') survives the strip, is counted as an AFFIRMATIVE selloff claim, and on a mild day (|VN-Index|<2%, ~0 floor) FALSE-BLOCKS a correct non-panic post. FIX (1): add 'chưa' and common variants ('chưa phải','chưa từng') to the negation-stripping lexicon. FIX (2): replace `\d` with `[0-9]` in the floor-stock regex `chỉ \d mã sàn` (line ~361) — BSD grep -E on macOS treats `\d` literally; `[0-9]` is GNU/BSD portable.
items.generic_mandate: Broaden the negation lexicon generically (any 'chưa'-prefixed negation of panic language), not a one-off literal; the [0-9] portability fix applies to EVERY `\d` in the gate's grep -E patterns — audit the whole script for stray `\d` while here.

Add a contrasting fixture with an AFFIRMATIVE 'thị trường bán tháo, hoảng loạn' on a mild day -> Check-C MUST still BLOCK. items.title: cowork last_fired is bumped on spawn DISPATCH-success, not delivery proof -> a spawn that dies before writing its notebook still satisfies the cadence gate -> genuine slot misses are MASKED (matcher never re-offers)
items.description: RAW-verified 2026-06-26 from cowork-dispatcher signals (00:19Z cowork_spawn_completion + 00:22Z blind-correction) and confirmed in docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/last-fired.md Step 5b: last_fired updates for WON_SLOTS where 'won' = the run_in_background spawn handle returned (AC-P1-7-1 'last_fired written after successful spawn'), NOT delivery confirmation (notebook mtime advance / marker file). A backgrounded spawn that dispatches then dies before delivering still bumps last_fired; cowork-match-slots.js then reads the bumped stamp, sees the 4h cadence satisfied, and never re-offers the slot -> the miss is invisible. OBSERVED: news-scout-offhours 00:00 master-cron fire bumped last_fired 00:02:36Z but produced NO c108 notebook cycle (latest real c108 @ 06-25T16:04Z; both 20:00 and 00:00 slots un-run), while sibling bctc-analyst-slot-4 + market-watcher-offhours DID deliver real cycles -> gateway was up -> the news-scout spawn died before delivery. Same masking class as the prior bctc-analyst-slot-3 master-cron gap. The dispatcher only caught it via an ad-hoc marker-safe recovery spawn (which then turned out blind) — there is no SYSTEMIC delivery-confirmation gate.
items.fix_spec: ARCHITECT confirm zone split + design first (do NOT pre-commit to an approach). The hard constraint: spawns are run_in_background (fire-and-forget) so the dispatcher CANNOT synchronously await delivery within one tick. Candidate designs to evaluate: (A) DEFERRED-CONFIRM ledger — on spawn, record a pending_delivery{slot_id, dispatched_at, expected_artifact} marker and DO NOT bump last_fired; on a SUBSEQUENT tick, bump last_fired only if the slot's delivery artifact (notebook mtime > dispatched_at, or a per-slot delivery marker) advanced, else re-offer the slot (bounded retry budget to avoid thrash). (B) POST-SPAWN short delivery poll before the Step 5b write (bounded, < tick budget). (C) artifact-driven cadence — derive 'last delivered' from the slot's real delivery artifact mtime rather than a dispatch-stamped field, making last_fired advisory. Architect picks; BA decomposes into dev-ready fix_spec+files. cowork-schedule.json is _maintained_by agent-father via architect brief ONLY (never direct edit) — flow-doc + matcher changes route to dev-mcp-server / agent-father per the split.
items.generic_mandate: Cadence suppression MUST be gated on DELIVERY PROOF, not dispatch success, for ALL fire-and-forget cowork slots (not just news-scout) — a slot whose spawn dispatched but never delivered must remain due. Applies to every */4h + guaranteed slot in cowork-schedule.json. No hardcoded slot lists — derive from the schedule.
items.verification_gate: Simulate a slot whose spawn DISPATCHES successfully but produces NO delivery artifact (no notebook mtime advance / no marker) within the delivery window -> last_fired is NOT advanced (or the slot is re-offered next tick) AND the matcher re-offers it on the next cron period; a slot that DOES deliver advances last_fired exactly once and is correctly suppressed. Both behaviors covered by cowork-match-slots.test.js (or its successor). Confirm no re-fire thrash on a slow-but-eventually-delivering spawn (bounded retry).

items.title: task_claim owner_session is server-INSTANCE-scoped (pid+startupTs), not client-scoped -> concurrent clients on one mcp-server collapse to one owner identity -> re-entrant self-reclaim returns claimed:true -> mutual exclusion DEFEATED (cowork double-fire)
items.root_cause: apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/system/coordinationTools.ts:52-56 SERVER_SESSION_ID is a single module-level const `pid-${process.pid}-ts-${startMs}` computed ONCE per process and stamped as owner_session on EVERY claim (L117) regardless of caller. Doc comment L18 (coordinationStore.ts) + L11/L20-21 (coordinationTools.ts) state owner_session SHOULD be the per-client Claude Code session id injected by the gateway, but the live value proves the unshipped Phase-2 fallback (process pid+boot) is active. Two concurrent clients sharing one mcp-server therefore get the IDENTICAL owner_session -> a second client's claim on a held lock is treated as a re-entrant SELF-reclaim -> claimed:true -> leader-lock + per-slot mutex CANNOT serialize concurrent dispatchers.
items.raw_verification: router dev-team tick 2026-06-26T05:22Z + PO RAW-confirm via task_list_held: SIX concurrent locks across FOUR distinct owner_agents (dev-team, unified-agent, cowork-dispatcher, cowork-team) ALL carry the IDENTICAL owner_session pid-1-ts-1782423559593 (server uptime ~7.8h, matches auditor Tier-1 7h33m). Older locks from prior server lifetimes carry DIFFERENT ts (1782401745780, 1782362316958, ...) confirming owner_session rotates ONLY on mcp-server restart, NOT per client. Code root confirmed in coordinationTools.ts:52-56,117.
items.observed_impact: cowork DOUBLE-FIRE this session: news-scout-sentiment spawned twice (a89c1b41@05:02 + a404d93d@05:03); chef slots fired twice (a29c5bcd@05:16 + parallel@05:21). BOUNDED not corrupting: published:<slot>:<date|hour> marker gate prevented double MARKET posts; gatherers have E3/exec-proof idempotency. Damage = wasted spawns/fetches, not bad data.

RAW-verify on the live lock table before/after (re-run task_list_held: two concurrent claimers must show DISTINCT owner_session).

items.title: SBV-FX (+news) SLA: post-publish-window relaxation + poll-cadence tolerance band
items.root_cause: getSlaThreshold() (freshnessSlaChecker.ts L646-652) applies the tight defaultThresholdMinutes (30) for the WHOLE VN business day whenever isVnSbvBusinessDay(now)==true. But SBV publishes FX once/day; its publish window ends 10:00 UTC (lastExpectedSbvWindowEnd L530). After 10:00Z no new sbv_fx arrives until the next business-day window, yet the 30-min tight SLA stays active all day -> age sawtooths against the ~30-min fetcher poll cadence and breaches HIGH at the top of every cycle (Fri 10:33Z age 37/30). The DONE FIX-SLA-EXEMPT-NEWS-SBVFX relaxes ONLY on non-business days (weekend/holiday); the post-publish-window-on-a-business-day window AND the SLA==poll-cadence sawtooth are uncovered. Same structural pattern hits news (tight 30-min SLA for the whole 00:00-14:59Z window vs ~30-min poll -> news sawtoothed OK->32/30 in the same tick). Same over-fire CLASS as B-11 (market-hours-blind) and C-06 (off-market).
items.fix_spec: 1) Post-window relaxation on business days: in the SBV branch, once now is PAST lastExpectedSbvWindowEnd for today, switch to (minutesSinceLastSbvWindowEnd + grace) instead of the tight 30-min -> the tight SLA applies DURING the expected publish window only, not all day. Mirror for news post-14:59Z. 2) Tolerance band so SLA never equals poll cadence: breach HIGH only when age > MAX(threshold*1.5, threshold + pollCadence); a 30-min SLA on a 30-min poller must not fire on a single-cycle slip. Apply uniformly to news + sbv_fx.
items.generic_mandate: Derive publish-window-end + poll-cadence from config per source; do NOT hardcode per-source magic. The post-window relaxation + tolerance band must cover BOTH news and sbv_fx (and be safe for any once-per-window source).
items.verification_gate: On any post-10:00Z business-day time get_sla_status returns sbv_fx ok (not HIGH); news ok post-14:59Z. A genuine >1.5x stall DURING the live publish window still breaches. Add unit tests in freshnessSlaChecker.spec for business-day-post-window + single-cycle sawtooth tolerance.

items.title: Same-tick CHEF mutual-exclusion in cowork dispatch — suppress non-guaranteed chef-* slots when a guaranteed chef slot matches the same tick, in BOTH pressure modes (closes legacy-mode cadence-bypass double-publish)
items.root_cause: Two independent gaps both fire on the once-per-weekday 05:15 nominal tick where chef-morning cron (15 5) and chef-intraday cron (13 2-8) coincide: (1) pressure-state.stale_warning=true (DETERMINISTIC — cycle-snapshot age > _staleness_threshold_minutes=20, correctly reporting stale data) forces PRESSURE_MODE=legacy at Step 4.2; legacy mode sets CADENCE_MATCHES = raw MATCHES with NO filtering (pressure-cadence.md Step 4.5b), so the cadence gate that would have suppressed chef-intraday (off-market default 240min vs ~62min elapsed) is bypassed. (2) No same-tick CHEF mutex: published-marker keys differ per slot (published:chef-morning:DATE vs published:chef-intraday:DATE:HH) so they never collide, and chef-intraday's conditional logic does not detect the guaranteed morning dish that published 0-1min earlier.
items.fix_spec: Fix A (robust, per payload §06:21Z): add an UNCONDITIONAL same-tick CHEF mutual-exclusion in the dispatch tick (runs in BOTH adaptive AND legacy modes, because legacy mode is entered LEGITIMATELY whenever pressure data is stale). After MATCHES is resolved (pressure-cadence.md Step 4.5b rebind, or match-slots.md Step 4b collision guard): if MATCHES contains a guaranteed chef-* slot (slot.guaranteed==true AND slot_id matches ^chef-), drop every non-guaranteed chef-* slot from MATCHES for that tick and log a suppression telemetry line. Do NOT touch emit_pressure_state / stale_warning (fix C) — the flag is deterministic and correctly reports stale snapshots; suppressing it would mask real staleness.

items.status_note:
AC: apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/analysis/sequential-market-analysis.ts registerSequentialMarketAnalysisTools() calls server.registerTool("sequential_market_analysis", {title,description,inputSchema,handler:tool.handle}) — WRONG shape. The real SDK signature (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0, node_modules/.pnpm/@modelcontextprotocol+sdk@1.29.0_zod@3.25.76/node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/dist/esm/server/mcp.js:699 registerTool(name,config,cb) + .d.ts:150-157) destructures config for {title,description,inputSchema,outputSchema,annotations,_meta} ONLY — config.handler is silently dropped, and no 3rd cb arg is ever passed, so the SDK's internal registeredTool.handler is permanently undefined. server.ts's per-call telemetry wrapper (createBunServer -> createMcpServerInstance, ~line 326: const originalHandler = toolDef.handler; toolDef.handler = async (args) => { incrementTool(toolName); return originalHandler(args); }) then throws "originalHandler is not a function" on EVERY real invocation, over EVERY transport (registration bug lives in tool registration, shared by /mcp and /sse+/messages — transport-agnostic).

Fix: change the registerTool call to server.registerTool("sequential_market_analysis", {title,description,inputSchema:tool.schema}, tool.handle) (schema+handler as SEPARATE positional args, matching the SDK contract every other tool file in this repo already uses via the server.tool(name,description,schema,handler) 4-arg legacy API — see apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/market-data/marketTools.ts:147 for the working pattern).

CONFIRMED PRE-EXISTING: git show 1b1397025^:apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/analysis/sequential-market-analysis.ts shows a byte-identical broken registerTool call BEFORE the FACTORY-INTERFACE-sequential-confidence-05-mask confidence-fabrication fix landed — that fix never touches registerSequentialMarketAnalysisTools, zero relationship to this defect.

Repro (against the live swapped mcp-server, image 180382145ee7): curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/mcp -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"sequential_market_analysis","arguments":{"analysisType":"hypothesis_test","thought":"t","thoughtNumber":1,"totalThoughts":1,"nextThoughtNeeded":false,"hypothesis":"h"}}}' -> {"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"originalHandler is not a function. (In 'originalHandler(args)', 'originalHandler' is undefined)"}],"isError":true},...}.

Sanity-checked the bug is scoped to this one tool, not the /mcp route itself: get_market_snapshot (registered via the correct server.tool(...) 4-arg API) called over the same route on the same container returns real correct data.

DoD: real tools/call over /mcp against sequential_market_analysis returns a valid {status,thought,progress,nextSteps} payload (no isError); FACTORY-INTERFACE-sequential-confidence-05-mask.test.ts + tool-registry-parity.test.ts stay green (5/5 + 22/22); a new regression test added asserting an end-to-end registerTool()+tools/call round-trip (not just tool.handle() called directly) so this class of registration-shape bug cannot silently recur.

items.title: OHLCV depth-shortfall R-5 alert re-fires forever on permanently-shallow non-watchlist honest-gap codes (BDI/DLC/JSH/SIS/VDC) — make the emitter honest-gap-aware
items.note: PIPELINE ROOT ALREADY FIXED: OPS-OHLCV-VPS-BACKFILL-STALL-NONWATCHLIST DONE_VERIFIED 2026-07-08T02:12Z (deploy-vinahost.sh gap deploying /root/fetch-ohlcv-backfill.sh; 109 ok/3 skipped/0 err/77434 bars), archived. RESIDUAL = alert noise only: /api/ohlcv-backfill-done (ohlcvBackfillHandler.ts ~L230-252) re-queues depth-shortfall codes, and at retry_count>=5 (R-5 cap) fires the [OHLCV-DEPTH] BUG alert with NO exemption for codes that can never hit DEPTH_FLOOR=252. items.title: F1.4 Write scripts/cowork-launchers/*.sh (session-alive→no-op else spawn, task_claim dedup) + launchd plists for the 5 active slots
items.desc: Build the LOCAL launchd backstop for the 5 active cloud-triggered guaranteed slots (brief Pillar-3), using the proven com.vn-market.fleet-push.plist pattern (launchd/). One launcher script per slot in scripts/cowork-launchers/ that: (1) probes whether the CronCreate */15 master dispatcher session is alive (ps aux | grep cron-cowork-team); (2) if ALIVE → NO-OP (Layer-1 fires the slot within ±2 min); (3) if DEAD → directly spawn the cowork agent via the slot's flow_path with its trigger_prompt; (4) task_claim(task_kind=cowork-slot, ttl_seconds=900) dedup so a launchd fire + the */15 dispatcher within the same window don't double-fire (second spawn sees claimed=false, exits silently — brief Collision-safety). The 5 REAL active slots (cowork-schedule.json, ground-truth slot_ids — NOT the brief's loose labels): chef-morning (15 5 * * 1-5 → flow chef.md), chef-eod (45 8 * * 1-5 → chef.md), chef-evening (45 19 * * * → chef.md), digest-sunday (47 13 * * 0 → digest-predict/main.md), tnb-audit (13 20 * * * → tran-ngoc-bau/main.md). Each plist uses StartCalendarInterval matching the slot cron. Independent of all DB/code work — runs in parallel with F1.1-F1.3. Persist scripts to scripts/cowork-launchers/ (never /tmp) + add a pointer in the owning cowork flow doc per dev-standards Script Persistence.
items.acceptance: DoD: (1) scripts/cowork-launchers/launch-{chef-morning,chef-eod,chef-evening,digest-sunday,tnb-audit}.sh exist, each session-alive-checks then no-op-or-spawn with task_claim cowork-slot dedup; (2) 5 launchd plists in launchd/ (StartCalendarInterval matching each slot cron); (3) smoke-tested on install (same discipline as fleet-worktree-push.sh — brief Risk mitigation); (4) launcher pointer added to the owning cowork flow doc. NOTE: this task only WRITES + smoke-tests; the 2-successful-fires-per-slot gate that releases F1.5 is logged by ops install/operation, not asserted here.

Distinct from the off-season SLA false-positive (FIX-BCTC-SLA-THRESHOLD-360) and the cosmetic stale-fetch artifact. Recon must (a) confirm BOTH filings are published on source (HOSE/HNX/SSC), then (b) trace WHICH stage drops each: DISCOVER (enumerate/list) vs PULL vs ENRICH — investigate discovery FIRST since queue=0 points there.
